scripts.api:serve: docker run --rm -it -v "$PWD/apps/api:/app" -w /app -p 8080:8080 php:8.4-cli php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=8080
scripts.api:migrate: docker run --rm -v "$PWD/apps/api:/app" -w /app php:8.4-cli php artisan migrate --force
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d postgres redis mailpit
